newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells Sep 23-30 diesel at $25.50-$25.55/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells Sep 23-30 diesel at $25.50-$25.55/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petrolem Corp (CPC) sold by tender 225,000-250,000 barrels of 0.3 percent sulphur diesel at $25.50-$25.55 per barrel on a free-on-board (fob) basis from Kaohsiung, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The cargo, for September 23-30 lifting, was bought by a Singapore-based oil trading firm, he said. The tender attracted seven bids.
In its last tender, CPC sold 225,000-250,000 barrels of diesel near $24.50 per barrel for August 23-30 lifting, fob Kaohsiung.
